fold.intro: Who the Riders are, what drives the Tyrants and why your Shard is pulling.

worlds.label: The five layers
worlds.note: Cut from runs in the game.

forest.name: Primeval Forest
forest.line: Where time runs slow, the Unfolded still wield stone and fury.
forest.alt: A run in the Primeval Forest, seen from above: grass, a stone wall and creatures.

gear.name: Gearworks
gear.line: Where time runs fast, the Unfolded arrive in iron and smoke.
gear.alt: A run in Gearworks, seen from above: a floor of steel plates and machines.

lava.name: Caldera
lava.line: Where time has barely begun, the Unfolded took the volcano from the tribes.
lava.alt: A run in Caldera, seen from above: basalt, ash and rock creatures.

ice.name: Glacier
ice.line: Where time has all but stopped, the Unfolded took the frozen lake from the fishers.
ice.alt: A run in Glacier, seen from above: a frozen lake with snow along the edges.

reef.name: Atoll
reef.line: Where time has long since sunk the volcano, the Unfolded closed the channels and took the lagoon from the stilt-house folk.
reef.alt: A run in Atoll, seen from above: pale sand, coral and reef creatures.

forest.name: Forest Tyrant
forest.alt: Forest Tyrant: a tree-like body covered in moss, with a crown of Amber.

gear.name: Gearworks Tyrant
gear.alt: Gearworks Tyrant: purple and gold armour with gears and Amber crystals.

lava.name: Caldera Tyrant
lava.alt: Caldera Tyrant: a magma golem with Amber crystals.

ice.name: Glacier Tyrant
ice.alt: Glacier Tyrant: an ice giant with a crown of crystals and a purple cape.

reef.name: Atoll Tyrant
reef.alt: Atoll Tyrant: a dark red crab with a golden crown and one huge claw.

figures.threeRifts: Painting: the Rider shoots while three Rifts open onto different worlds.
figures.threeRiftsCaption: Three Rifts, three layers: Glacier, Caldera and Forest.
figures.amberCaption: Amber of the Fold, as it appears in the nests.
figures.riderRift: Painting: the Rider before an open Rift, the Shard glowing on his chest.
figures.seal: The Seal: a shield with two golden layers and a cyan crystal between them.
figures.sealCaption: The Seal, symbol of the order.
